slides.title: Welcome to the Office
slides.content:
1. Key Vocabulary

  • Reception: The front desk where guests arrive.
  • Elevator / Lift: To go up or down floors.
  • Restroom: (Bathroom/Toilet).
  • Meeting Room: A room for team discussions.
  • Hallway / Corridor: The long passage between rooms.

2. Prepositions of Place

To say where something is, we use:

Next to: Al lado de
Opposite: Enfrente de
Between: Entre
On the right: A la derecha
slides.speech_text: Welcome. Today you will learn how to navigate an office building. We will practice vocabulary like reception, elevator, and meeting room. We will also learn prepositions like next to, and opposite.

slides.title: Asking for Directions
slides.content: Listen to the conversation between a new employee and the receptionist.
slides.audio_script:
Employee: Excuse me, where is Meeting Room 3B?
        Receptionist: It is on the second floor.
        Employee: How do I get there?
        Receptionist: Go straight down this hallway, take the elevator to the 2nd floor, and turn left. It's opposite the kitchen.
        Employee: Thank you!

quiz.question: What is the room opposite to?

slides.title: Where is it?
slides.instruction: Select the correct preposition based on the context.

questions.explanation: 'Next to' indica que está al lado.

questions.text: The CEO's office is _____ the end of the hall.
questions.explanation: Usamos 'at' para puntos específicos: 'At the end'.

questions.text: To get to the exit, please turn _____.
questions.explanation: Directions: Turn left (gira a la izquierda) or Turn right.

slides.title: Roleplay: Lost in the Building
slides.system_prompt:
You are an office assistant named Alex.
        The user is a new employee who is lost.
        Your goal is to give them directions politely using: 'Go straight', 'Turn left/right', 'Next to', 'On the X floor'.
        
        Scenario:
        1. User asks where a specific room is (e.g., the bathroom or cafeteria).
        2. You give clear instructions.
        3. If they say thank you, welcome them to the team.
slides.initial_message: Hi! You look a bit lost. Can I help you find a specific room?
slides.user_goal: Ask where the 'Cafeteria' is and follow the instructions.
